Class Rivet

java.lang.Object
yams.core.Rivet
public final class Rivet extends Object
Rivet, the YASS mascot, says hi on the Driver Station display when YAMS starts up.

The splash is written once, the first time a YAMS motor controller config or swerve drive is built. The Display panel docked in the Driver Station shows about 26 columns by 9 rows, so it gets a short welcome with the YAMS version, yassrobotics.com and the live tuner, plus an arrow to the panel's pop-out button. Popping the display out (or scrolling right) shows Rivet at full resolution with a random phrase from Rivet under it. It uses DriverStationDisplay line mode, so robot code that writes its own lines afterwards simply replaces it.
